slides.stat_label: Cash Limits Per Transfer, and Where Each Applies
bullets: Bank branch cash, sent by NEFT: up to ₹50,000
BC or ATM: ₹5,000 each; monthly cap per sender
Cash pay-out: ₹10,000 each; ₹25,000 a month per receiver
